tasks.title_zh: 检验机理能否迁移到新应用工况
tasks.input_requirements: Locked candidate + parent + original validated scope + requested target scope. Source and target must differ concretely in fuel/pressure/temperature/dilution/observable, not only in wording. T08-N requires specific disjoint or shifted envelopes at assembly; no claim these constitute pristine unseen data. Bundle pending selection.
